SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
GROUP BY team_long_name
HAVING AVG(chanceCreationPassing) < (SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) FROM Team_Attributes)
ORDER BY AVG(chanceCreationPassing) DESC;

SELECT team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed = 31
AND buildUpPlayDribbling = 53

SELECT Team.team_long_name
FROM Team
JOIN `Match` ON Team.team_api_id = `Match`.away_team_api_id
JOIN League ON `Match`.league_id = League.id

GROUP BY Team.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM

  name = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT

FROM 
    cards

    language = 'Japanese';

FROM cards c

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards

FROM cards 
WHERE rarity = 'rare'

SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion, uuid

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN c1.convertedManaCost > c2.convertedManaCost THEN c1.name
        ELSE c2.name
    END AS card_with_more_converted_mana
FROM 
    cards c1
JOIN 
    cards c2 ON c1.name = 'Serra Angel' AND c2.name = 'Shrine Keeper'
WHERE 
    c1.convertedManaCost > c2.convertedManaCost OR c2.convertedManaCost > c1.convertedManaCost;
